title: AI Darling on the Hot Seat: Will Palantir Deliver?
excerpt: Palantir posted blowout earnings while its stock cratered 30% this year, creating a tension that forces a hard question about whether the market is punishing...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • PLTR carries a BUY rating and $157 12-month target as Q1 revenue surged 85% despite the stock falling 31% in 2026.

  • Palantir's 85% revenue growth triples ServiceNow's pace while its $870M GAAP profit sets it apart from loss-making Snowflake.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Palantir didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Palantir (NASDAQ:PLTR) has been the AI trade's mascot and lightning rod. After a searing multi-year run, the stock has cooled sharply in 2026, giving bulls and skeptics fresh ammunition. Our proprietary model sees room to run, but the setup is more nuanced than current price action suggests.

The stock trades at $125.96 as of August 3, 2026. Our 24/7 Wall St. price target is $157.22 over the next 12 months, implying 24.83% upside. Our recommendation is buy with high conviction (90% confidence).

A Painful 2026 That Masks a Blowout Quarter

PLTR is down 30.77% year to date and 22.29% over the past year, sitting 12% below its 52-week high of $207.52.

Yet fundamentals move the other way. Q1 2026 revenue landed at $1.63 billion, up 84.71% year over year, with adjusted EPS of $0.33 beating consensus by 18.07%. U.S. commercial revenue grew 133%, and management raised full-year 2026 guidance to $7.65 billion to $7.662 billion, roughly 71% growth.

The disconnect between price and results reflects valuation compression while business quality remains strong.

Why Bulls See a Breakout Ahead

The bull case rests on a Rule of 40 score of 145%, which CEO Alex Karp noted is "matched only by other fellow AI infrastructure companies: NVIDIA, Micron and SK hynix".

U.S. commercial remaining deal value hit $4.92 billion (up 112%), net dollar retention hit 150%, and adjusted operating margin expanded to 60%. If AIP adoption continues, our bull scenario sees PLTR reaching $201.63, a 60.08% gain.

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Palantir didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

The Street's consensus target of $182.20, supported by 20 Buy ratings, sits inside that range.

What Could Go Wrong

At a trailing P/E of 138 and forward P/E of 84, any deceleration matters. Stock-based compensation of $201.6 million in Q1 alone is meaningful, though bulls note this reflects aggressive engineering investment in AIP as legacy contracts carry termination for convenience risk.

  • Palantir 85% 的收入增长是 ServiceNow 的三倍，而其 8.7 亿美元的 GAAP 利润使其与亏损的 Snowflake 区分开来。

Palantir（纳斯达克股票代码：PLTR）一直是人工智能行业的吉祥物和避雷针。 经过多年的猛烈上涨后，该股在 2026 年大幅降温，为多头和怀疑者提供了新的弹药。 我们的专有模型看到了运行空间，但其设置比当前价格走势所暗示的更为微妙。

截至 2026 年 8 月 3 日，该股交易价格为 125.96 美元。 我们未来 12 个月 24/7 华尔街的目标价格为 157.22 美元，意味着上涨 24.83%。 我们的建议是坚定信念地买入（90% 的置信度）。

痛苦的 2026 年掩盖了井喷的季度

PLTR 今年迄今下跌 30.77%，去年下跌 22.29%，比 52 周高点 207.52 美元低 12%。

然而，基本面却朝着相反的方向发展。 2026 年第一季度营收为 16.3 亿美元，同比增长 84.71%，调整后每股收益 0.33 美元，超出市场预期 18.07%。 美国商业收入增长 133%，管理层将 2026 年全年指导上调至 76.5 亿美元至 76.62 亿美元，增长约 71%。

价格与业绩之间的脱节反映出估值压缩，而业务质量仍然强劲。

为什么多头看到未来突破

看涨的理由基于 40 规则得分为 145%，首席执行官 Alex Karp 指出，“只有其他 AI 基础设施公司可以与之媲美：NVIDIA、美光和 SK 海力士”。

美国商业剩余交易价值达到 49.2 亿美元（增长 112%），美元净保留达到 150%，调整后营业利润率扩大到 60%。 如果 AIP 继续采用，我们的牛市情景中 PLTR 将达到 201.63 美元，涨幅为 60.08%。

立即行动：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 Palantir 却没有上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

在 20 个买入评级的支持下，华尔街的一致目标为 182.20 美元，位于该范围内。

可能会出现什么问题

追踪市盈率为 138，远期市盈率为 84，任何减速都很重要。 仅第一季度 2.016 亿美元的基于股票的薪酬就很有意义，尽管多头指出这反映了对 AIP 的积极工程投资，因为遗留合同存在因便利而终止的风险。
